instruction: I need to create a backup copy of slide 4 in the same presentation. Could you open the LibreOffice Impress file on my Desktop, duplicate slide 4, and save the file?

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(1)

metadata.explanation: Task requires duplicating slide 4 (titled 'GraphTitle'). Evaluator checks that there are now at least 2 slides with the title 'GraphTitle'.

llm_judge_reasons: Core verification logic is semantically correct: checks that 2 slides with title 'GraphTitle' exist after duplication
Postconfig properly ensures file is saved before verification (Ctrl+S)
Getter implementation is fragile: checks if ANY shape's text matches 'GraphTitle', not specifically title placeholder shapes
Risk of false positives: if 'GraphTitle' appears in body text or other text boxes on different slides, they would be incorrectly counted
Getter doesn't use proper PPTX shape type checking (e.g., checking placeholder type or shape.has_text_frame with is_title property)
Verification assumes 'GraphTitle' only appears as slide titles, which may not be guaranteed
Despite implementation flaws, evaluator will likely work correctly if 'GraphTitle' is cleanly used only as title text in the presentation
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Improve getter to specifically check for title placeholder shapes instead of any shape with matching text
Use python-pptx shape properties like 'shape.placeholder_format' to identify title placeholders
Add defensive checks to filter for shapes that are actually title placeholders (placeholder_format.type == PP_PLACEHOLDER.TITLE)
Consider checking slide position/index to verify the duplicate is adjacent to original slide 4
Add validation that the counted slides have identical content/layout, not just matching titles
